## Pangolin (CR 1/4)

This long-bodied creature is covered in scales on its upper body that resemble a pine cone.  

**XP** 200  
N Tiny animal  
**Init** +2; **Senses** low-light vision, scent; Perception +8  


**Defense**


**AC** 16, touch 14, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +2 natural, +2 size)  
**hp** 9 (1d8+1)  
**Fort** +3, **Ref** +4, **Will** +1  
**Defensive Abilities** protective ball  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** claw -1 (1d3-3)  
**Space** 2-1/2 ft.; **Reach** 0 ft.  
**Special Attacks** musk  


**Statistics**


**Str** 4, **Dex** 14, **Con** 12, **Int** 2, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 8  
**Base Attack** +0; **CMB** +0; **CMD** 7 (11 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Skill Focus (Perception)  
**Skills** Perception +8  


**Special Abilities**


**Familiar** The master of a pangolin familiar gains a +1 natural armor bonus to AC.  

**Musk (Ex)** Up to twice per day, a pangolin can spray a stream of noxious musk at a single target within 10 feet as a standard action. With a successful ranged touch attack, the creature struck by this spray must make a DC 12 Fortitude save or be nauseated 1 for 1d4 rounds and then sickened for 1d4 minutes by the horrific stench. A successful save reduces the effect to only 1d4 rounds of being sickened. A creature cannot use the scent ability as long as it is affected by this musk. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

**Protective Ball (Ex)** A pangolin can roll up into a ball as a swift action, increasing its natural armor bonus to +3 but decreasing its speed to 0 feet. Unrolling is a move action.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** warm plains  
**Organization** solitary or mating pair  
**Treasure** none
